items.headline: UNC posts Bill Belichick’s signed employment agreement. Term through December 31, 2029. University without-cause (§12) pays remaining Base $1M + Supplemental $9M only through December 31, 2027; 2028–29 are $0 on a university fire. No mitigation in §12.

Iowa State posts Jimmy Rogers’s employment agreement. Term through January 31, 2032. Without-cause is 100% of remaining Base ($3,000,000/year). Six remaining contract years × $3M = $18,000,000 at the start of the current year. Offset if hired at another D-I school; no duty to seek work.

Clemson 2022 BOT term sheet (binding until a restated EA) sets Dabo Swinney through December 31, 2031. University without-cause is $57,000,000 flat if terminated in 2026, then remaining Base + Supplemental + Licensing for 2027–2031. No mitigation.

Michigan owes $0 on Sherrone Moore’s firing — for cause, no buyout.

UCLA paying DeShaun Foster’s $7.4 million buyout through 2028, subject to offset.

Virginia Tech settled Brent Pry at $3.1 million over two years after he returned as Franklin’s coordinator (headline $6 million).
Oklahoma State paying Mike Gundy’s $15 million buyout over three years, subject to offset.
Texas Tech files a Galaxy Stadium naming deal: 15 years, around $75 million (~$5 million AAV). Replaces Jones AT&T Stadium.
Indiana’s Merchants Bank Field naming: 20 years / $50 million (playing surface, not the bowl). AAV $2.5 million if spread flat.
Arkansas files a $70 million / 14-year CommunityAmerica stadium naming (~$5.4 million AAV). Name changes July 1, 2027.
Arizona Athletics release: Casino Del Sol Stadium naming, $60 million-plus over 20 years.
Illinois Athletics books a $100 million Larry Gies gift; stadium renamed Gies Memorial Stadium. A gift, not a commercial AAV.
South Carolina’s 10-year Nike partnership begins. Guaranteed product + cash + supplement $77.5 million / 10 ($7.75 million AAV).
Texas Tech FOIA: 10-year Adidas deal signed Dec. 6, 2024 — $59.25 million ($50 million product + $9.25 million cash).

News-Gazette FOIA: UNC Nike annual cash compensation $3.25 million (2023–24). Product allotment not extracted.
